judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, runtimePatterns.drop.outOfRangeMath: the refusal survives, including the critical promise that the largest listed conductor is NOT returned as a recommendation.

bt-1291.translation: Aucun conducteur répertorié ne réussit les deux vérifications. La recherche de chute de tension a trouvé {dropStatus}; la recherche de courant admissible a trouvé {ampacityStatus}. Modifiez la conception ou demandez à un électricien qualifié d’évaluer les conducteurs ou dispositions hors de cet outil.
bt-1291.backTranslation: No listed conductor passes both checks. The voltage-drop search found {dropStatus}; the ampacity search found {ampacityStatus}. Change the design or ask a qualified electrician to evaluate conductors or arrangements outside this tool.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, runtimePatterns.drop.outOfRangeNote: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1292.translation:
Nous avons vérifié chaque calibre, du plus petit au plus gros, jusqu’à ce qu’un calibre garde la chute sous votre limite de {percent}% ({maxDrop} V) :

{size} ({cm} cmil) : {mult} × {factor} × {amps} A × {feet} ft ÷ {cm} = {dropped} V = {actualPercent}% ✓ sous votre limite
bt-1292.backTranslation:
Each gauge was checked from smallest upward until one kept the drop below your {percent}% limit ({maxDrop} V):

{size} ({cm} cmil): {mult} × {factor} × {amps} A × {feet} ft ÷ {cm} = {dropped} V = {actualPercent}% ✓ below your limit

judgment.verdict: The smallest-first search, below-limit direction, named values, units, and check mark all retain their meaning.

bt-1293.translation: plus petit conducteur en {material} qui garde la chute sous {percent}%

judgment.verdict: The result still identifies the smallest material-specific wire that remains below the stated percentage.

bt-1294.translation: Cet outil dimensionne le conducteur selon la chute de tension. Le conducteur doit aussi être homologué pour transporter le courant sans surchauffer, ce qui exige un autre calcul et d’autres tableaux. À l’extérieur, dans un conduit et au soleil, les facteurs de correction comptent. Vérifiez-les :
bt-1294.backTranslation: This tool sizes the conductor according to voltage drop. The conductor must also be approved to carry the current without overheating, which requires another calculation and other tables. Outdoors, in a conduit, and in the sun, correction factors matter. Check them:

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, solarWireSize.ampacityBody: the separation of voltage drop from ampacity survives, as does the derating warning.

bt-1295.translation: Les cibles de chute utilisées par cet outil sont des points de départ issus de la pratique solaire courante, non des exigences du code. Aucune règle du code n’impose 2%. Le fabricant de votre équipement peut exiger une valeur plus serrée, et sa valeur l’emporte. L’outil affiche la cible utilisée pour que vous puissiez la modifier en connaissance de cause plutôt que de l’accepter sans le savoir.
bt-1295.backTranslation: The drop targets used by this tool are starting points from common solar practice, not code requirements. No code rule requires 2%. Your equipment manufacturer may require a tighter value, and its value takes precedence. The tool displays the target used so that you can change it knowingly rather than accept it without realizing it.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, solarWireSize.targetsBody: the essential honesty survives: the targets are practice, not code, no rule requires 2%, and the manufacturer figure takes precedence.

bt-1296.translation: Vérifiez toujours les calculs indépendamment, respectez le code de l’électricité et les permis locaux, et engagez un professionnel autorisé lorsque la loi ou la prudence l’exige.
bt-1296.backTranslation: Always verify calculations independently, comply with local electrical code and permits, and hire a licensed professional when the law or prudence requires it.

judgment.verdict: “follow your” is rendered as “comply with”; verification, local-code compliance, and professional help remain required (ca-fr/fr-CA, bt-0256).

bt-1297.translation: N’attaquez pas le Service, ne le surchargez pas, ne recueillez pas son contenu à un rythme abusif, ne faites pas d’ingénierie inverse dans le but de nuire et ne l’entravez pas autrement. Ne l’utilisez pas non plus en violation de la loi.
bt-1297.backTranslation: Do not attack the Service, overload it, collect its content at an abusive rate, reverse engineer it for the purpose of causing harm, or otherwise obstruct it. Also do not use it in violation of the law.

judgment.verdict: “Don't” is rendered as “Do not”; all prohibited conduct remains prohibited (ca-fr/fr-CA, bt-0257).

bt-1298.translation: Les travaux électriques peuvent blesser ou tuer, et les erreurs peuvent causer des incendies.
bt-1298.backTranslation: Electrical work can injure or kill, and mistakes can cause fires.

judgment.verdict: The back-translation is byte-identical—literal wording was recovered for “Electrical work can injure or kill, and mistakes can cause fires.”; injury, death, and fire risks are retained (ca-fr/fr-CA, bt-0258).

bt-1299.translation: Pour les calculs fondés sur le code canadien, VoltDrop met en œuvre CSA C22.1:24 — Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, 26th edition (2024) : Tables 2, 4, 5A, 5C et 22, ainsi que Rules 4-004, 4-006, 8-102, 8-104, 12-3034 et 14-104.
bt-1299.backTranslation: For calculations based on the Canadian code, VoltDrop implements CSA C22.1:24 — Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, 26th edition (2024): Tables 2, 4, 5A, 5C, and 22, as well as Rules 4-004, 4-006, 8-102, 8-104, 12-3034, and 14-104.

judgment.verdict: The Quebec French retains the exact Canadian standard edition and the complete implemented citation list.

bt-1300.translation: Pour les calculs fondés sur le code américain, VoltDrop met en œuvre l’édition 2023 de NFPA 70 — National Electrical Code (NEC) : Table 310.16, Tables 310.15(B)(1) et 310.15(C)(1), 240.4(D) et 110.14(C). Ses outils de remplissage de conduit et de boîte utilisent aussi NEC Chapter 9 Tables 4 et 5 ainsi que NEC 314.16, y compris Tables 314.16(A) et 314.16(B).
bt-1300.backTranslation: For calculations based on the U.S. code, VoltDrop implements the 2023 edition of NFPA 70 — National Electrical Code (NEC): Table 310.16, Tables 310.15(B)(1) and 310.15(C)(1), 240.4(D), and 110.14(C). Its conduit-fill and box-fill tools also use NEC Chapter 9 Tables 4 and 5 and NEC 314.16, including Tables 314.16(A) and 314.16(B).

judgment.verdict: The Quebec French preserves the 2023 NEC basis and every listed ampacity, conduit, and box citation.

bt-1301.translation: . Si vous n’êtes pas d’accord, n’utilisez pas le Service.
bt-1301.backTranslation: . If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

judgment.verdict: “don't” is rendered as “do not”; non-agreement still means the service must not be used (ca-fr/fr-CA, bt-0259).

bt-1302.translation: Les résultats sont des estimations simplifiées pour des conditions normales. Ils ne tiennent pas compte de tous les facteurs réels (température, regroupement, réduction du courant admissible, charges continues, modifications locales au code, homologations d’équipement et autres). Le Service ne remplace pas un électricien autorisé ni un ingénieur professionnel, et son utilisation ne crée aucune relation professionnelle.
bt-1302.backTranslation: The results are simplified estimates for normal conditions. They do not account for all real-world factors (temperature, grouping, ampacity reduction, continuous loads, local code modifications, equipment approvals, and others). The Service does not replace a licensed electrician or professional engineer, and its use creates no professional relationship.

judgment.verdict: The back-translation adds “The”; normal-condition limits and unmodeled safety factors remain (ca-fr/fr-CA, bt-0260).

bt-1303.translation: Les États, les provinces et les municipalités adoptent les codes selon des calendriers différents et peuvent y ajouter des modifications locales. Un résultat exact selon l’édition mise en œuvre par VoltDrop peut être erroné là où une édition antérieure ou une modification locale s’applique. Vous devez confirmer l’édition adoptée par votre propre autorité compétente.
bt-1303.backTranslation: States, provinces, and municipalities adopt codes on different schedules and may add local amendments. A result that is accurate under the edition implemented by VoltDrop may be wrong where an earlier edition or local amendment applies. You must confirm the edition adopted by your own competent authority.

judgment.verdict: The Quebec French keeps the local-adoption risk and uses mandatory force for confirming the authority’s edition.

bt-1304.translation: Dans toute la mesure permise par la loi, VoltDrop et son exploitant ne sont responsables d’aucun dommage découlant de votre utilisation du Service ou de votre incapacité à l’utiliser, notamment les dommages matériels, les blessures, la perte de profits ou le coût de reprise des travaux électriques, peu importe le fondement invoqué. Si la responsabilité ne peut être entièrement exclue, notre responsabilité totale est limitée à $50 (USD). Certaines régions n’autorisent pas certaines exclusions; des parties des présentes peuvent donc ne pas s’appliquer à vous.
bt-1304.backTranslation: To the fullest extent permitted by law, VoltDrop and its operator are not liable for any damage arising from your use of or inability to use the Service, including property damage, injuries, lost profits, or the cost of redoing electrical work, regardless of the basis invoked. If liability cannot be fully excluded, our total liability is limited to $50 (USD). Some regions do not allow certain exclusions; parts of these terms may therefore not apply to you.

judgment.verdict: “damages” is rendered as “damage”; $50 USD, damage categories, and jurisdiction caveat remain (ca-fr/fr-CA, bt-0261).

bt-1305.translation: Les traductions sont fournies par souci de commodité. En cas d’incompatibilité entre une version traduite et la version anglaise, la version anglaise prévaut.
bt-1305.backTranslation: Translations are provided for convenience. If a translated version is incompatible with the English version, the English version prevails.

judgment.verdict: The Quebec French clearly says the English version prevails if a translated version is incompatible.

bt-1306.translation: VoltDrop emploie parfois une méthode simplifiée ou prudente. Par exemple, CEC Rule 4-006 limite l’exigence de température aux terminaisons aux premiers 1.2 m du conducteur et permet ensuite une transition conforme au Code. VoltDrop ne modélise pas cette division; il applique la plus basse des températures nominales du conducteur et de la terminaison à toute la longueur. Cette méthode est prudente, mais elle ne constitue pas la procédure complète du Code.
bt-1306.backTranslation: VoltDrop sometimes uses a simplified or cautious method. For example, CEC Rule 4-006 limits the termination-temperature requirement to the first 1.2 m of the conductor and then permits a code-compliant transition. VoltDrop does not model this division; it applies the lower of the conductor and termination temperature ratings to the entire length. This method is cautious, but it is not the Code’s complete procedure.

judgment.verdict: The Quebec French retains 1.2 m, the permitted transition, the lower whole-length rating, and the simplified-method caveat.

bt-1307.translation: Lorsqu’un Code ne règle pas expressément un détail de mise en œuvre, VoltDrop peut faire un choix prudent que votre inspecteur ou votre autorité locale peut ne pas partager. Par exemple, CEC Rule 4-004 ne traite pas expressément des conducteurs de réserve installés pour la puissance ou l’éclairage; VoltDrop les compte aux fins de Table 5C.
bt-1307.backTranslation: When a Code does not expressly settle an implementation detail, VoltDrop may make a cautious choice that your local inspector or authority may not share. For example, CEC Rule 4-004 does not expressly address installed spare conductors for power or lighting; VoltDrop counts them for purposes of Table 5C.

judgment.verdict: The Quebec French accurately preserves Code silence, possible local disagreement, and conservative Table 5C counting.

bt-1308.translation: Vous pouvez ouvrir une session avec Google ou Facebook pour laisser des commentaires. Vous demeurez propriétaire de vos écrits, mais vous nous accordez une licence mondiale et libre de redevances pour les afficher dans le Service. Ne publiez rien d’illégal, de haineux, de harcelant, de trompeur ou d’indésirable; aucun lien, renseignement personnel sur autrui ou usurpation d’identité. Nous pouvons supprimer tout commentaire ou suspendre l’accès aux commentaires à notre discrétion, avec ou sans avis. Les commentaires expriment l’opinion d’autres utilisateurs, pas la nôtre, et ne constituent jamais une source de conseils électriques professionnels.
bt-1308.backTranslation: You may sign in with Google or Facebook to leave comments. You remain the owner of your writings, but grant us a worldwide, royalty-free license to display them in the Service. Do not post anything illegal, hateful, harassing, deceptive, or unwanted; no links, personal information about others, or impersonation. We may delete any comment or suspend access to comments at our discretion, with or without notice. Comments express the opinions of other users, not ours, and never constitute a source of professional electrical advice.

judgment.verdict: “can” is rendered as “may”; ownership, license, prohibitions, moderation, and no-advice warning remain (ca-fr/fr-CA, bt-0262).

bt-1309.translation: Vert ou vert avec des rayures jaunes selon CEC Rule 4-032. Ces couleurs sont réservées à la mise à la terre et à la continuité des masses.
bt-1309.backTranslation: Green or green with yellow stripes, in accordance with CEC Rule 4-032. These colors are reserved for grounding and bonding.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.bondAnswer: the bonding colours and the cited rule survive.

bt-1310.translation: Utilisez le vert ou le vert avec des rayures jaunes. Au-dessus de #2 AWG, un marquage permanent est permis à chaque extrémité et point accessible; ces couleurs sont réservées à la mise à la terre et à la continuité des masses.
bt-1310.backTranslation: Use green or green with yellow stripes. Above #2 AWG, permanent marking is permitted at each end and accessible point; these colors are reserved for grounding and bonding.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.bondNote: the bonding colours and the re-identification allowance for larger conductors survive.

bt-1311.translation: Dans un panneau triphasé standard, les circuits 1 et 2 sont sur la phase A, 3 et 4 sur B, 5 et 6 sur C, puis la séquence se répète.
bt-1311.backTranslation: In a standard three-phase panel, circuits 1 and 2 are on phase A, 3 and 4 on B, 5 and 6 on C, and then the sequence repeats.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.circuitAnswer: the 1&2=A, 3&4=B, 5&6=C repeating bus pattern survives with the phase letters intact.

bt-1312.translation: Utilisez ceci pour les travaux neufs; la barre réelle se confirme au multimètre. Vérifiez au multimètre avant de toucher quoi que ce soit.
bt-1312.backTranslation: Use this for new work; confirm the actual bus with a multimeter. Check with a multimeter before touching anything.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.circuitMeterLine: the meter instruction survives, including that the tool is for new work and the actual bus is a measurement question.

bt-1313.translation: CEC Rule 4-032 utilise le noir et le rouge pour les conducteurs monophasés, ajoute le blanc lorsqu’un neutre est requis et fixe le triphasé à A rouge, B noir, C bleu. Le vert et le vert/jaune sont réservés à la mise à la terre et à la continuité des masses.
bt-1313.backTranslation: CEC Rule 4-032 uses black and red for single-phase conductors, adds white when a neutral is required, and sets three-phase colors as A red, B black, C blue. Green and green/yellow are reserved for grounding and bonding.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.countryRuleBody: the country rule and its conditional survive with the correct code body.

bt-1314.translation: Lorsque le codage par couleur est exigé, CEC Rule 4-032 fixe ces couleurs.
bt-1314.backTranslation: When color coding is required, CEC Rule 4-032 specifies these colors.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.countryScope: the conditional scope of the colour requirement survives.

bt-1315.translation: Non. La couleur indique ce qui devrait être installé; elle ne prouve pas la fonction d’un conducteur existant.
bt-1315.backTranslation: No. Color indicates what should be installed; it does not prove the function of an existing conductor.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.existingAnswer: the critical refusal survives: colour states what SHOULD be installed and does not prove what an existing conductor is.

bt-1316.translation: Le Canada place le conducteur ayant la tension la plus élevée par rapport à la terre sur la phase A. Le NEC place la branche haute sur la phase B.
bt-1316.backTranslation: Canada places the conductor with the higher voltage to ground on phase A. The NEC places the high leg on phase B.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.highLegAnswer: the cross-border difference survives exactly -- Canada phase A, NEC phase B -- with neither side flipped or dropped.

bt-1317.translation: Dans un réseau delta canadien à 4 fils, la phase A est le conducteur ayant la tension la plus élevée par rapport à la terre. Le NEC place la branche haute sur la phase B.
bt-1317.backTranslation: In a Canadian 4-wire delta system, phase A is the conductor with the higher voltage to ground. The NEC places the high leg on phase B.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.highLegBody: the country-correct high-leg position survives, as does the contrast with the other country.

bt-1318.translation: La phase A est la branche haute et demeure rouge dans la séquence triphasée.
bt-1318.backTranslation: Phase A is the high leg and remains red in the three-phase sequence.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.highLegNote: the high-leg position and its identification survive.

bt-1319.translation: Cet outil indique quoi installer dans des travaux neufs. Le câblage ancien, l’isolant décoloré et les erreurs passées rendent la couleur peu fiable pour l’identification.
bt-1319.backTranslation: This tool indicates what to install in new work. Old wiring, discolored insulation, and past errors make color unreliable for identification.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.installBody: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1320.translation: Entrez un numéro de circuit entier de 1 ou plus.
bt-1320.backTranslation: Enter a whole-number circuit number of 1 or greater.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.invalidCircuit: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1321.translation: Blanc lorsqu’un neutre est requis selon CEC Rule 4-032; Rule 4-024 traite de l’identification permise en blanc avec une rayure de couleur.
bt-1321.backTranslation: White when a neutral is required, in accordance with CEC Rule 4-032; Rule 4-024 covers permitted identification using white with a colored stripe.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.neutralAnswer: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1322.translation: Utilisez le blanc lorsqu’un neutre est requis. Rule 4-024 traite aussi de l’identification permise en blanc avec une rayure de couleur.
bt-1322.backTranslation: Use white when a neutral is required. Rule 4-024 also covers permitted identification using white with a colored stripe.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.neutralNote: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1323.translation: Les rangées d’un panneau triphasé standard suivent A, B, C par paires répétées. Dans un réseau delta à 4 fils, la règle canadienne fait de la phase A le conducteur ayant la tension la plus élevée par rapport à la terre; ne transposez pas la position américaine sur la phase B.
bt-1323.backTranslation: The rows of a standard three-phase panel follow A, B, C in repeating pairs. In a 4-wire delta system, the Canadian rule makes phase A the conductor with the higher voltage to ground; do not transfer the U.S. phase B position.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.panelArrangementBody: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1324.translation: Il s’agit de la couleur prescrite pour le conducteur sélectionné.
bt-1324.backTranslation: This is the prescribed color for the selected conductor.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.phaseNote: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1325.translation: Ceci indique quoi installer dans des travaux neufs. Ce qui est déjà dans le mur se vérifie au multimètre — vérifiez au multimètre avant de toucher quoi que ce soit.
bt-1325.backTranslation: This indicates what to install in new work. What is already in the wall must be checked with a multimeter—check with a multimeter before touching anything.

judgment.verdict: For ca-fr, wireColour.roleMeterLine: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1326.translation: Des calculateurs électriques qui montrent comment chaque résultat est obtenu. Sans inscription, sans deviner.
bt-1326.backTranslation: Electrical calculators that show how each result is obtained. No registration, no guessing.

judgment.verdict: The French rendering naturally states how every result is obtained and retains the promises of no signup and no need to guess.

bt-1339.translation: AWG = American Wire Gauge。该标识印在导线护套上。
bt-1339.backTranslation: AWG = American Wire Gauge. This marking is printed on the conductor jacket.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, ampacity.aWGAmericanWireGaugeItSPrinted preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.
For ca-zh, ampacity.aluminumButton preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.
The zh-Hans ambient wording preserves the listed-row selection rule, including its temperature boundary and rounding direction.
The zh-Hans ambient wording preserves the listed-row selection rule, including its temperature boundary and rounding direction.

bt-1343.translation: 对于介于两点之间的温度，采用下一个更高的已列行；绝不插值或向下取整。
bt-1343.backTranslation: For a temperature between two points, use the next higher listed row; never interpolate or round down.

judgment.verdict: The zh-Hans ambient wording preserves the listed-row selection rule, including its temperature boundary and rounding direction.

bt-1344.translation: CEC Table 5A仅列出30°C以上的单点环境温度。30°C或以下采用1.00，不给予低温增容。输入位于两个列出温度之间时，本计算器采用下一个更高温度行；绝不插值或向下取整。
bt-1344.backTranslation: CEC Table 5A lists only single ambient-temperature points above 30°C. At 30°C or below, use 1.00, with no cooler-temperature credit. When the input falls between two listed temperatures, this calculator uses the next higher temperature row; it never interpolates or rounds down.

judgment.verdict: The zh-Hans ambient wording preserves the listed-row selection rule, including its temperature boundary and rounding direction.
For ca-zh, ampacity.ambientTemperatureLabel preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.
For ca-zh, ampacity.ampacityAnd preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.

bt-1347.translation: 🔥 加拿大载流量与降容检查

judgment.verdict: The zh-Hans back-translation faithfully preserves the safety meaning, numbers, units, and cited designations for ampacity.ampacityCheckTitle.

bt-1348.translation: 载流量是导体在规定条件下不过热时可承载的最大电流。本加拿大计算器采用CSA C22.1:24 — Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, 26th edition (2024)中的Tables 2/4、5A和5C，以及Rules 4-004、4-006、8-104和14-104。
bt-1348.backTranslation: Ampacity is the maximum current a conductor can carry under stated conditions without overheating. This Canadian calculator uses CSA C22.1:24 — Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, 26th edition (2024), Tables 2/4, 5A and 5C, and Rules 4-004, 4-006, 8-104 and 14-104.

judgment.verdict: The zh-Hans back-translation faithfully preserves the safety meaning, numbers, units, and cited designations for ampacity.ampacityIsTheMaximumCurrentInAmpsAnswer.

bt-1349.translation: 应用加拿大环境温度和导体数量系数，然后查看哪项CEC安全上限起决定作用。
bt-1349.backTranslation: Apply the Canadian ambient-temperature and conductor-count factors, then see which CEC safety cap controls.

judgment.verdict: The zh-Hans back-translation faithfully preserves the safety meaning, numbers, units, and cited designations for ampacity.ampacityTheMostCurrentAWireCan.

bt-1350.translation: 是两项独立检查；导线必须同时通过
bt-1350.backTranslation: are two independent checks; the conductor must pass both

judgment.verdict: “separate” is rendered as “two independent”; the checks remain independent and still must be passed (ca-zh/zh-Hans, bt-0264).

bt-1351.translation: 基础载流量 — CEC Table 2/4（绝缘温度栏）

judgment.verdict: The zh-Hans back-translation faithfully preserves the safety meaning, numbers, units, and cited designations for ampacity.baseAmpacityLabel.
For ca-zh, ampacity.bindingLimitLabel preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.
For ca-zh, ampacity.bindingMarker preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.
For ca-zh, ampacity.both preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.
For ca-zh, ampacity.checkAmpacityButton preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.
The zh-Hans back-translation faithfully preserves the safety meaning, numbers, units, and cited designations for ampacity.conductorAdjustmentLabel.
For ca-zh, ampacity.conductorSideDeratingSummary preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.
For ca-zh, ampacity.conductorsUnit preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.

bt-1359.translation: 单独计算的连续负载要求超过最终允许载流量。
bt-1359.backTranslation: The separately calculated continuous load requirement exceeds the final allowable ampacity.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, ampacity.continuousLoadFailsLabel preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.

bt-1360.translation: 对于标准80%额定设备，CEC Rule 8-104将连续负载限制为校正载流量的80%。这是独立检查，不是降容系数。
bt-1360.backTranslation: For standard 80%-rated equipment, CEC Rule 8-104 limits a continuous load to 80% of corrected ampacity. This is a separate check, not a derating factor.

judgment.verdict: The zh-Hans back-translation keeps the separate continuous-load check and its required 80% treatment without changing force.

bt-1361.translation: 单独计算的连续负载要求在最终允许载流量以内。
bt-1361.backTranslation: The separately calculated continuous load requirement is within the final allowable ampacity.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, ampacity.continuousLoadPassesLabel preserves the stated concept and safety direction; its independent back-translation keeps the original meaning and force.

bt-1362.translation: 连续负载上限（校正载流量 × 80%）

judgment.verdict: The zh-Hans back-translation keeps the separate continuous-load check and its required 80% treatment without changing force.

bt-1363.translation: 连续负载选型与导体降容回答不同问题。对于标准80%额定设备，CEC Rule 8-104检查连续负载是否不超过校正载流量的80%。该检查绝不与125%乘数同时使用。

bt-1587.backTranslation: The verified 60°C column gives #6 copper only 55 A, so that method selects #4 copper, counted at 70 A. The verified 75°C column gives #6 copper 65 A. CEC Rule 4-006 and the equipment markings together determine which termination limit applies.

judgment.verdict: The #6-versus-#4 explanation keeps 55 A and 65 A tied to the correct columns, and the 'unless the installation supports the 75°C column' condition is preserved; '一律' (always) merely restates the default without changing it.

bt-1589.translation: 我们核验过的计算器选出 #4 铜芯（41,740 cmil）：2 × 12.9 × 60 × 150 ÷ 41,740 = 5.56 V，相对 240 V 是 2.32%。结果通过了载流量核对，也满足强制的 3% 电压降限值。
bt-1589.backTranslation: Our verified calculator selects #4 copper (41,740 cmil): 2 × 12.9 × 60 × 150 ÷ 41,740 = 5.56 V, which is 2.32% relative to 240 V. The result passes the ampacity check and also meets the mandatory 3% voltage-drop limit.

judgment.verdict: The full worked calculation 2 × 12.9 × 60 × 150 ÷ 41,740 = 5.56 V at 2.32% of 240 V is reproduced digit for digit, and both the ampacity pass and the mandatory 3% drop limit are stated.

bt-1590.translation: TT-30 房车插座是 120 V。普通距离下起步用 10 AWG 铜芯 NMD90，实际单程距离请用 120 V 表格或计算器核对。
bt-1590.backTranslation: A TT-30 RV receptacle is 120 V. For ordinary distances start with 10 AWG copper NMD90, and verify your actual one-way distance with the 120 V table or the calculator.

judgment.verdict: The TT-30 receptacle stays a 120 V device, the 10 AWG copper NMD90 starting size is kept, and the instruction to verify the actual one-way run with the 120 V table or calculator is intact.

bt-1591.translation: 经核验的 60°C 栏给 #8 铝芯 35 A，所以这里也列出了铝线。请到加拿大载流量核对工具里确认导体类型、端子和设备认证。
bt-1591.backTranslation: The verified 60°C column gives #8 aluminum 35 A, so aluminum wire is also listed here. Please confirm the conductor type, terminations, and equipment certification in the Canadian ampacity check tool.

judgment.verdict: #8 aluminum at 35 A under the verified 60°C column is preserved, and rendering 'equipment listing' as equipment certification is a fair equivalent for CSA/UL listing in the confirm step.

bt-1592.translation: 不能。CEC Rule 14-104 把 12 AWG 铜芯限制在 20 A 的过电流保护装置上（普通电路），所以它通不过 30 A 的载流量核对。
bt-1592.backTranslation: No. CEC Rule 14-104 limits 12 AWG copper to a 20 A overcurrent protection device (ordinary circuits), so it does not pass the 30 A ampacity check.

judgment.verdict: The refusal is unambiguous: Rule 14-104's 20 A overcurrent cap on 12 AWG copper for ordinary circuits and the resulting failure of a 30 A ampacity check both come through.
The 30 A table cell value '1' is carried over unchanged, which is all this numeric string requires.
This table entry '10' in the 30 A guide is byte-identical across translation and back-translation.
The AWG size designation '1/0' is kept exactly, with the slash notation for aught sizes untouched.
The standalone table value '2' for the 30 A guide passes through with no numeric alteration.
Cell content '3' in the 30 A conductor table is identical in every version, so nothing was lost.
The numeral '4' used as a wire-size table cell is reproduced exactly as in the English source.
The wire-gauge cell '6' remains the same figure throughout, preserving the 30 A table's data.
Table value '8' for the 30 A circuit guide shows no change between source and rendered text.

bt-1601.translation: 普通 30 A 电路，起步用 10 AWG 铜芯 NMD90。TT-30 房车插座是 120 V，而典型的烘干机或热水器电路是 240 V；这个电压差会改变长距离时的选线。
bt-1601.backTranslation: For an ordinary 30 A circuit, start with 10 AWG copper NMD90. A TT-30 RV receptacle is 120 V, while a typical dryer or water-heater circuit is 240 V; that voltage difference changes the wire choice over long distances.

judgment.verdict: The 10 AWG copper NMD90 starting answer, the 120 V TT-30 versus 240 V dryer/water-heater contrast, and the point that voltage changes long-run sizing all survive accurately.

bt-1602.translation: 在 120 V 下，我们核验过的计算器选出 #6 铜芯（26,240 cmil）：2 × 12.9 × 30 × 100 ÷ 26,240 = 2.95 V，占 2.46%。240 V 表格的规格更小，因为损失同样的电压，占比只有一半。
bt-1602.backTranslation: At 120 V, our verified calculator selects #6 copper (26,240 cmil): 2 × 12.9 × 30 × 100 ÷ 26,240 = 2.95 V, which is 2.46%. The 240 V table's sizes are smaller because losing the same amount of voltage is only half the percentage.

judgment.verdict: The 120 V worked example keeps #6 copper, 26,240 cmil, the full formula equaling 2.95 V and 2.46%, plus the explanation that equal volts lost are half the percentage at 240 V.

bt-1603.translation: 普通 20 A 分支电路请用 12 AWG 铜芯 NMD90。CEC Rule 14-104 把 14 AWG 铜芯限制在 15 A，因此这种普通用途下不能配 20 A 过电流保护装置。
bt-1603.backTranslation: For an ordinary 20 A branch circuit, use 12 AWG copper NMD90. CEC Rule 14-104 limits 14 AWG copper to 15 A, so for this ordinary use it cannot be given a 20 A overcurrent protection device.

judgment.verdict: The 12 AWG answer for ordinary 20 A branch circuits and Rule 14-104's 15 A cap on 14 AWG, barring a 20 A overcurrent device for this use, are both rendered faithfully.

bt-1604.translation: CEC Rule 14-104 把 14 AWG 铜芯限制在 15 A，12 AWG 铜芯限制在 20 A（普通电路）。NMD90 更高的绝缘等级并不能抹掉过电流保护装置的这个上限。
bt-1604.backTranslation: CEC Rule 14-104 limits 14 AWG copper to 15 A and 12 AWG copper to 20 A (ordinary circuits). NMD90's higher insulation rating does not erase this overcurrent-protection-device cap.

judgment.verdict: Both caps (14 AWG at 15 A, 12 AWG at 20 A) are correct with the ordinary-circuit scope kept, and the negation that NMD90's insulation rating cannot erase the cap is intact.
The 20 A guide's table cell '10' matches the source numeral exactly with nothing added or dropped.
The bare value '3' in the 20 A conductor table is transferred without any numeric drift.
For the 20 A table, the cell '4' is unchanged across the translation round trip.
The gauge figure '6' in the 20 A guide's table stays precisely as written in English.
The 20 A table's entry '8' is preserved verbatim, so the data row is uncorrupted.

bt-1610.translation: 我们核验过的计算器选出 #8 铜芯（16,510 cmil）：2 × 12.9 × 20 × 100 ÷ 16,510 = 3.13 V，相对 120 V 是 2.6%。结果通过了载流量核对，也满足强制的 3% 电压降限值。
bt-1610.backTranslation: Our verified calculator selects #8 copper (16,510 cmil): 2 × 12.9 × 20 × 100 ÷ 16,510 = 3.13 V, which is 2.6% relative to 120 V. The result passes the ampacity check and also meets the mandatory 3% voltage-drop limit.

judgment.verdict: The #8 copper selection at 16,510 cmil, the arithmetic yielding 3.13 V and 2.6% of 120 V, and both the ampacity pass and mandatory 3% limit are all reproduced without error.

bt-1611.translation: 不行。本站没有核验过对应的加拿大允许值，所以这里不会把美国的百分比算法当成加拿大的选型规则来用。
bt-1611.backTranslation: No. This site has not verified the corresponding Canadian permitted values, so it will not use the US percentage method here as a Canadian sizing rule.

judgment.verdict: The refusal keeps its force: no verified Canadian allowance exists, so the U.S. percentage method is explicitly not applied as a Canadian sizing rule on this site.

bt-1612.translation: 美国版在 NEC 方法下把 2/0 铜芯、3/0 铜芯和 4/0 铝芯这几个答案的来龙去脉理顺了。加拿大是通过 Section 8 自己的计算负荷规则给住宅供电进线选型的，本站尚未核验到能给出一个标题级导体答案的程度。
bt-1612.backTranslation: The US version works through the reasoning behind the 2/0 copper, 3/0 copper, and 4/0 aluminum answers under the NEC method. Canada sizes residential service conductors through Section 8's own calculated-load rules, and this site has not been verified to the point of giving a headline-level conductor answer.

judgment.verdict: The 2/0 and 3/0 copper and 4/0 aluminum figures under NEC methods are exact, and Canada's Section 8 calculated-load sizing with no verified headline conductor answer is conveyed; 'reconciles' as working through the reasoning is a fair rendering.

bt-1613.translation: 加拿大的 200 A 供电进线需要按加拿大的方法计算，并经过当地审查。本页不会照搬美国 NEC 的导体规格，也不会自己编一个加拿大对应值。
bt-1613.backTranslation: A Canadian 200 A service needs to be calculated by the Canadian method and pass local review. This page will not copy the US NEC conductor sizes, nor will it make up a Canadian equivalent on its own.

judgment.verdict: Both prohibitions stand: the page neither publishes a U.S. NEC conductor size nor invents a Canadian equivalent, and the need for a Canadian calculation with local review is stated.

bt-1614.translation: 用加拿大载流量核对工具，把拟定的导体规格拿去核对经核验的载流量表。不供全屋的馈线工作，请用加拿大子配电盘指南。这两步都不能替代 Section 8 的供电进线计算。
bt-1614.backTranslation: Use the Canadian ampacity check tool to check the proposed conductor size against the verified ampacity tables. For feeder work that does not supply the whole house, use the Canadian subpanel guide. Neither of these steps replaces the Section 8 service calculation.

judgment.verdict: The tool-versus-guide split is correct, the sub-panel guide is properly scoped to feeders not supplying the whole dwelling, and the warning that neither step replaces the Section 8 calculation is kept.

bt-1615.translation: 凭本站现有的经核验资料做不到。Section 8 的负荷计算和当地采用的要求，必须由有资质的加拿大电工或设计人员来执行。
bt-1615.backTranslation: Not with the verified material this site currently has. The Section 8 load calculation and the locally adopted requirements must be carried out by a qualified Canadian electrician or designer.

judgment.verdict: The limitation on this site's verified material and the requirement that a qualified Canadian electrician or designer apply the Section 8 load calculation and locally adopted rules are both faithfully preserved.

bt-1616.translation: 数据表通过核查后，我们会计算其数字指纹，并把指纹保存在代码仓库中。此后，只要表中有一个数字发生变化，验证套件就会在浏览器测试开始前停止，并报告不一致。重新核查数据和有意更新所存指纹是两个独立的人工步骤，封印本身无法强制执行。
bt-1616.backTranslation: After a data table passes review, we calculate its digital fingerprint and store the fingerprint in the code repository. From then on, if a single number in the table changes, the verification suite stops before the browser tests begin and reports the discrepancy. Rechecking the data and deliberately updating the stored fingerprint are two separate human steps; the seal itself cannot enforce them.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.afterATablePassesWeTakeAFingerprint: the corrected scope survives: the SEAL stops the verification suite, and re-verifying plus updating the fingerprint are named as separate human steps rather than something the seal enforces.

bt-1617.translation: 回译可以发现遗漏的警告和被扭曲的含义。它是一道筛查，不是正确性的证明。
bt-1617.backTranslation: Back translation can detect missing warnings and distorted meanings. It is a screening step, not proof of correctness.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.backTranslationCatchesMissingWarnings: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1618.translation: 封印能够证明数字没有在无人察觉的情况下发生变化，但不能证明原始数字一定正确。原始数据是否正确由多来源核查负责。这是两道不同的保护，各自完成不同的任务。
bt-1618.backTranslation: The seal can prove that a number did not change without anyone noticing, but it cannot prove that the original number was correct. Verifying whether the original data is correct is the role of the multiple-source check. These are two different protections, each performing a different task.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.beClearAboutWhatThisDoesAndDoesnTProve: the multiple-source wording carries over intact — the check is described as spanning more than one independently produced reproduction, and no claim about quantity or rigour is strengthened in translation.

bt-1619.translation: 各地自行采用并修订电气规范。您施工地点现行的版本，可能不是某张数据表所依据的版本。
bt-1619.backTranslation: Electrical codes are adopted and amended locally. The edition currently in effect at your work location may not be the edition on which a particular data table is based.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.codesAreAdoptedLocally: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1620.translation: 加拿大版数据采用 CSA C22.1:24 — Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, 26th edition (2024)：Tables 2/4、5A、5C、6A/6K和9A–9H，以及Rules 4-004、4-006、8-104、12-910和14-104。各省和市政地区的采用情况不同；请确认当地采用的版本。
bt-1620.backTranslation: The Canadian data uses CSA C22.1:24 — Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, 26th edition (2024): Tables 2/4, 5A, 5C, 6A/6K and 9A–9H, as well as Rules 4-004, 4-006, 8-104, 12-910 and 14-104. Adoption varies by province and municipality; confirm the locally adopted edition.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.dataEdition: the code edition and the full list of tables and rules survive verbatim, including the newly added 6A/6K, 9A-9H and Rule 12-910.

bt-1621.translation: 每个计算器都会在全部六个版本中实际运行，而不只测试英文版，并将答案与预期值核对——核心电压降案例的预期值由手工计算得出，其余案例则从封印数据表中推导。我们曾吃过这个亏：一次只运行英文版的测试显示全部通过，但主计算器在另外四个版本中根本无法使用。
bt-1621.backTranslation: Each calculator is actually run in all six editions, not just tested in English, and its answer is checked against an expected value—the expected values for the core voltage drop cases are calculated by hand, while those for the remaining cases are derived from the sealed data tables. We learned this the hard way: one test run that covered only the English edition showed that everything passed, but the main calculator was completely unusable in four other editions.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.everyCalculatorIsDrivenInAllSixEditions: the six-edition claim survives, and so does the corrected distinction between hand-worked expectations and ones derived from the sealed tables.

bt-1622.translation: 数值一致性检查覆盖已翻译的指南、条款页面以及包括本页在内的三个较新页面。在这些页面上，每个可见数字都会与对应英文页面核对；只有明确标记为合理本地差异的数值例外。
bt-1622.backTranslation: The numerical consistency check covers the translated guides, the Terms page, and three newer pages, including this one. On these pages, every visible number is checked against the corresponding English page; the only exceptions are values explicitly marked as legitimate local differences.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.everyNumberShownOnATranslatedPage: the corrected, narrower scope survives — named page groups rather than every translated page — including the explicit locale-difference exemption.

bt-1623.translation: 所以，请先看页面标签，不要想当然。若某个结果背后的数据尚未通过您所在国家的核查，页面会用直白的文字说明，而不会悄悄把它当作已经验证的答案呈现。
bt-1623.backTranslation: So please read the page labels first and do not take anything for granted. If the data behind a result has not yet passed review for your country, the page explains this in plain language instead of quietly presenting it as an already verified answer.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.ifAPageHereShowsYouAResult: the corrected instruction survives: read the label, because an unpassed result is disclosed rather than presented as verified. The former false guarantee is gone.

bt-1624.translation: 最终决定权在您当地的检查机构，不在我们。安装前，请按您所在地区实际采用的规则核对结果。
bt-1624.backTranslation: The final decision rests with your local inspection authority, not with us. Before installation, check the result against the rules actually adopted in your area.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.localAuthorityDecides: the transfer of authority to the local inspector and the instruction to confirm before installing both survive.

bt-1625.translation: VoltDrop 没有持证电工进行审查或认可。这里没有任何人以专业执照为这项工作背书。如果页面声称有，那就是错误，请告诉我们。
bt-1625.backTranslation: VoltDrop has no licensed electrician reviewing or endorsing it. No one here backs this work with a professional license. If a page claims otherwise, it is wrong; please tell us.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.noLicensedElectricianReviewsOrApproves: the disclaimer that no licensed electrician reviews or approves the site survives intact, including the instruction to report any page that claims otherwise.

bt-1626.translation: VoltDrop 与 CSA 没有隶属关系，也未获得其背书或认可。任何计算器都不存在“CEC 认证”，本页面也不例外。根本没有这种认证。
bt-1626.backTranslation: VoltDrop is not affiliated with CSA and has not been endorsed or approved by it. There is no “CEC certification” for any calculator, including this page. No such certification exists.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.notAffiliatedOrCertified: the non-affiliation statement and the denial that any code certification exists for calculators both survive; the country body is correct for this edition.

bt-1627.translation: 加拿大导管填充页面展示了数据缺口补齐后会发生什么。过去，加拿大导线和导管表格尚未通过多来源核查，因此页面带有警告。现在CSA C22.1:24 Tables 6A/6K和9A–9H已经通过核查，警告已移除，页面也改用封存的加拿大数据计算。我们宁可保留一个看得见的缺口，也不会过早填补；只有证据发生变化时才会移除警告。
bt-1627.backTranslation: The Canadian conduit fill page shows what happens when a data gap is filled. In the past, the page carried a warning because the Canadian conductor and conduit tables had not yet passed the multiple-source check. Now CSA C22.1:24 Tables 6A/6K and 9A–9H have passed the check, the warning has been removed, and the page now calculates using sealed Canadian data. We would rather leave a visible gap than fill it too soon; the warning is removed only when the evidence changes.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.ourCanadianConduitFillPageCarriesAPlanningNote: the corrected history survives: the page USED to carry a warning, the CEC tables have since passed, and the example now illustrates a gap closing rather than a gap standing open.

bt-1628.translation: 结果是按正常条件和简化方法得出的规划估算。实际安装中存在一些情况，而我们的输入项并未询问这些情况。
bt-1628.backTranslation: The results are planning estimates derived from normal conditions and simplified methods. Actual installations have conditions that our input fields do not ask about.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.resultsArePlanningEstimates: the limitation to simplified normal-conditions estimates survives, as does the warning that real installations have unasked-about conditions.

bt-1629.translation: 规范名称、导线类型和单位等绝不能翻译的词语，会在每种语言中检查是否原样保留。
bt-1629.backTranslation: In every language, we check that terms which must never be translated, such as code names, conductor types, and units, remain unchanged.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.termsThatMustNeverBeTranslated: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1630.translation: 世界上最容易的做法，是用一个看似合理的数字填满每个空缺，却对此只字不提。当某个国家专用表格尚未通过核查时，我们会在您即将依赖结果的位置标明边界，或拒绝给出答案。
bt-1630.backTranslation: The easiest thing in the world would be to fill every gap with a number that seems plausible and say nothing about it. When a country-specific table has not yet passed the check, we mark the boundary or refuse to provide an answer at the point where you are about to rely on the result.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.theEasiestThingWouldBeToFillEveryGap: the commitment survives in its generalised form -- an unpassed country table is either labelled at the boundary or refused, rather than silently filled.

bt-1631.translation: 英文页面会与上一次生成结果逐字节比较，避免任何意外改动。
bt-1631.backTranslation: The English pages are compared byte for byte with the previous generation to prevent any accidental changes.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.theEnglishPagesAreComparedByteForByte: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1632.translation: 这不是做样子。早期版本中的一个载流量草案值在不同来源之间不一致。核查发现了问题，并在发布前更正了该数值。这正是设置这一步的原因。
bt-1632.backTranslation: This is not for show. A draft ampacity value in an early version was inconsistent across different sources. The check found the problem, and the value was corrected before publication. That is exactly why this step exists.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.thisIsNotTheatreOneDraftAmpacity: the multiple-source wording carries over intact — the check is described as spanning more than one independently produced reproduction, and no claim about quantity or rigour is strengthened in translation.

bt-1633.translation: VoltDrop 不凭记忆录入数字。每张内置电气数据表在发布前，都要逐行逐格对照至少两份由不同人员独立制作的已发布表格复本。所有复本的每一个单元格都必须一致，否则就不会发布。
bt-1633.backTranslation: VoltDrop does not enter numbers from memory. Before publication, every built-in electrical data table is checked row by row and cell by cell against at least two reproductions of the published table independently produced by different people. Every cell in all reproductions must match, or it is not published.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.voltDropDoesnTTypeNumbersInFromMemory: the multiple-source wording carries over intact — the check is described as spanning more than one independently produced reproduction, and no claim about quantity or rigour is strengthened in translation.

bt-1634.translation: VoltDrop 以四种语言提供六个版本。安全警告在翻译中悄悄失去原意，会造成真实危险。因此我们会进行筛查：在不查看英文原文的情况下，单独把译文回译成英文，再将结果与原本要表达的含义比较。
bt-1634.backTranslation: VoltDrop provides six editions in four languages. A safety warning quietly losing its original meaning in translation creates a real danger. We therefore screen for this: without viewing the original English text, the translated text is independently translated back into English, and the result is compared with the meaning originally intended.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.voltDropShipsInSixEditionsAcrossFourLanguages: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1635.translation: 我们也会检查筛查过程本身。早期版本曾把几乎所有内容都判为完美，原因是英文原文混入了流程，系统只是把原文照样返回。那次结果被全部作废。之后我们重建了流程，把原文严格隔离在外。只要发现原文泄漏的迹象，该次结果就会被拒绝，而不会被采信。
bt-1635.backTranslation: We also check the screening process itself. An early version once judged almost everything perfect because the original English text had entered the process and the system simply returned it unchanged. All results from that run were invalidated. We then rebuilt the process to keep the original text strictly isolated. If any sign of original-text leakage is found, the run is rejected rather than accepted.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.weAlsoWatchTheScreenItself: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1636.translation: 我们已经测试确认：只改动一个数字也会触发封印。
bt-1636.backTranslation: We have tested and confirmed that changing even one number triggers the seal.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.weVeTestedThatTheSealFires: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1637.translation: 您即将根据屏幕上的一个数字选择导线规格。这里会准确说明该数字从何而来，以及我们如何尽力阻止错误数字出现。
bt-1637.backTranslation: You are about to choose a conductor size based on a number on the screen. Here we explain exactly where that number came from and how we try to prevent an incorrect number from appearing.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, howVerify.youReAboutToSizeAConductor: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1638.translation: 欧姆定律描述回路，但不能确定导线线径。线径取决于载流量（发热）和电压降（距离），而这两项都不在该方程中。请使用
bt-1638.backTranslation: Ohm’s law describes a circuit, but it cannot determine conductor size. Conductor size depends on ampacity (heat) and voltage drop (distance), and neither is in this equation. Please use

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, ohmsLaw.doesntSizeWire: the limitation that Ohm law does not size a conductor survives, with ampacity and voltage drop named as the governing factors.

You must confirm the edition adopted by the authority in your area.

judgment.verdict: The Canadian Chinese warning preserves varying adoption, amendment risk, and the user’s mandatory confirmation duty.

bt-1754.translation: 在法律允许的最大范围内，VoltDrop及其运营者不对您使用或无法使用本服务造成的任何损害负责，包括财产损失、人身伤害、利润损失或返工费用，无论责任依据是保证、合同、侵权还是其他理论。如果责任无法完全排除，我们的总责任以$50 (USD)为限。某些地区不允许特定免责条款，因此部分内容可能不适用于您。
bt-1754.backTranslation: To the maximum extent permitted by law, VoltDrop and its operator are not responsible for any damage caused by your use of or inability to use this Service, including property loss, personal injury, lost profits, or rework costs, whether liability is based on warranty, contract, tort, or another theory. If liability cannot be fully excluded, our total liability is limited to $50 (USD). Some regions do not allow specific disclaimers, so some content may not apply to you.

judgment.verdict: “fullest” is rendered as “maximum”; $50 USD, damage categories, and jurisdiction caveat remain (ca-zh/zh-Hans, bt-0349).

bt-1755.translation: 翻译版本仅为方便阅读而提供。如果翻译版本与英文版本不一致，以英文版本为准。
bt-1755.backTranslation: Translated versions are provided only for ease of reading. If a translated version is inconsistent with the English version, the English version controls.

judgment.verdict: The Canadian Chinese clause plainly gives the English version control over any inconsistent translation.

bt-1756.translation: VoltDrop有时采用简化或保守的方法。例如，CEC Rule 4-006将端接温度要求限制在导体起始的前1.2 m，并允许在其后进行符合规范的转换。VoltDrop不对这一分段建模，而是在全长范围内采用导体与端接温度额定值中的较低者。这种方法较为保守，但并不是规范的完整程序。
bt-1756.backTranslation: VoltDrop sometimes uses a simplified or conservative method. For example, CEC Rule 4-006 limits the termination-temperature requirement to the first 1.2 m from the start of the conductor and permits a code-compliant transition afterward. VoltDrop does not model this split; it uses the lower of the conductor and termination temperature ratings across the full length. This method is conservative, but it is not the code’s complete procedure.

judgment.verdict: The Canadian Chinese disclosure preserves the 1.2 m split, transition permission, conservative cap, and method limitation.

bt-1757.translation: 如果规范没有明确规定某项实施细节，VoltDrop可能会作出保守选择，而您的当地检查员或主管机构可能持不同意见。例如，CEC Rule 4-004没有明确说明已安装的备用功率或照明导体；VoltDrop会将其计入Table 5C。
bt-1757.backTranslation: If a code does not expressly specify an implementation detail, VoltDrop may make a conservative choice with which your local inspector or authority may disagree. For example, CEC Rule 4-004 does not expressly specify installed spare power or lighting conductors; VoltDrop counts them toward Table 5C.

judgment.verdict: The Canadian Chinese text retains the silence of Rule 4-004 and conservative spare counting toward Table 5C.

bt-1758.translation: 您可以使用Google或Facebook登录并发表评论。您保留所写内容的所有权，但授予我们在服务中展示该内容的全球性、免版税许可。请勿发布违法、仇恨、骚扰、欺骗或垃圾内容；请勿发布链接、他人个人信息或冒充他人。我们可以自行决定删除评论或暂停评论权限，无论是否另行通知。评论仅代表其他用户的意见，并非我们的意见，也绝不是专业电气建议的来源。
bt-1758.backTranslation: You may sign in with Google or Facebook and post comments. You retain ownership of what you write, but grant us a worldwide, royalty-free license to display that content in the Service. Do not post illegal, hateful, harassing, deceptive, or spam content; do not post links, other people's personal information, or impersonate others. We may decide at our sole discretion to remove comments or suspend commenting privileges, with or without separate notice. Comments represent only the opinions of other users, not ours, and are never a source of professional electrical advice.

judgment.verdict: “can” is rendered as “may”; ownership, license, prohibitions, moderation, and no-advice warning remain (ca-zh/zh-Hans, bt-0350).

bt-1759.translation: 根据 CEC Rule 4-032，使用绿色或绿色带黄色条纹。这些颜色仅保留给接地和等电位连接。
bt-1759.backTranslation: Use green or green with yellow stripes, in accordance with CEC Rule 4-032. These colors are reserved exclusively for grounding and bonding.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.bondAnswer: the bonding colours and the cited rule survive.

bt-1760.translation: 使用绿色或绿色带黄色条纹。大于 #2 AWG 时，可在每一端和可接近位置永久标记；这些颜色仅保留给接地和等电位连接。
bt-1760.backTranslation: Use green or green with yellow stripes. Above #2 AWG, permanent marking is permitted at each end and accessible location; these colors are reserved exclusively for grounding and bonding.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.bondNote: the bonding colours and the re-identification allowance for larger conductors survive.

bt-1761.translation: 在标准三相配电盘中，回路 1 和 2 为 A 相，3 和 4 为 B 相，5 和 6 为 C 相，之后重复。
bt-1761.backTranslation: In a standard three-phase panel, circuits 1 and 2 are phase A, 3 and 4 are phase B, 5 and 6 are phase C, and then the pattern repeats.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.circuitAnswer: the 1&2=A, 3&4=B, 5&6=C repeating bus pattern survives with the phase letters intact.

bt-1762.translation: 仅用于新安装；实际母排要用仪表确认。触碰任何导线之前，请先用仪表核实。
bt-1762.backTranslation: For new installations only; confirm the actual bus with a meter. Verify with a meter before touching any conductor.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.circuitMeterLine: the meter instruction survives, including that the tool is for new work and the actual bus is a measurement question.

bt-1763.translation: CEC Rule 4-032 对单相导线采用黑色和红色，需要中性线时加入白色；三相顺序为 A 相红色、B 相黑色、C 相蓝色。绿色和绿/黄色仅保留给接地和等电位连接。
bt-1763.backTranslation: CEC Rule 4-032 uses black and red for single-phase conductors and adds white when a neutral is required; the three-phase sequence is phase A red, phase B black, phase C blue. Green and green/yellow are reserved exclusively for grounding and bonding.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.countryRuleBody: the country rule and its conditional survive with the correct code body.

bt-1764.translation: 在要求采用颜色编码的回路中，CEC Rule 4-032 规定这些颜色。
bt-1764.backTranslation: For circuits that require color coding, CEC Rule 4-032 specifies these colors.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.countryScope: the conditional scope of the colour requirement survives.

bt-1765.translation: 不能。颜色说明应该安装什么，但不能证明现有导线的实际用途。
bt-1765.backTranslation: No. Color indicates what should be installed, but it cannot prove the actual use of an existing conductor.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.existingAnswer: the critical refusal survives: colour states what SHOULD be installed and does not prove what an existing conductor is.

bt-1766.translation: 加拿大把对地电压较高的导线放在 A 相。NEC 把高脚放在 B 相。
bt-1766.backTranslation: Canada places the conductor with the higher voltage to ground on phase A. The NEC places the high leg on phase B.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.highLegAnswer: the cross-border difference survives exactly -- Canada phase A, NEC phase B -- with neither side flipped or dropped.

bt-1767.translation: 在加拿大4线三角形系统中，A 相是对地电压较高的导线。NEC 把高脚放在 B 相。
bt-1767.backTranslation: In a Canadian 4-wire delta system, phase A is the conductor with the higher voltage to ground. The NEC places the high leg on phase B.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.highLegBody: the country-correct high-leg position survives, as does the contrast with the other country.

bt-1768.translation: A 相是高脚，并在三相颜色顺序中保持红色。
bt-1768.backTranslation: Phase A is the high leg and remains red in the three-phase color sequence.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.highLegNote: the high-leg position and its identification survive.

bt-1769.translation: 本工具说明新安装应采用什么颜色。旧线路、褪色绝缘层和既往错误都会使颜色不适合作为识别方法。
bt-1769.backTranslation: This tool indicates which color should be used for a new installation. Old wiring, faded insulation, and past errors make color unsuitable as a means of identification.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.installBody: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1770.translation: 请输入不小于 1 的整数回路编号。
bt-1770.backTranslation: Enter a whole-number circuit number no less than 1.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.invalidCircuit: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1771.translation: 根据 CEC Rule 4-032，需要中性线时使用白色；Rule 4-024 规定了允许采用的白色带彩色条纹识别方式。
bt-1771.backTranslation: Use white when a neutral is required, in accordance with CEC Rule 4-032; Rule 4-024 specifies permitted identification using white with a colored stripe.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.neutralAnswer: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1772.translation: 需要中性线时使用白色。Rule 4-024 还规定了允许采用的白色带彩色条纹识别方式。
bt-1772.backTranslation: Use white when a neutral is required. Rule 4-024 also specifies permitted identification using white with a colored stripe.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.neutralNote: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1773.translation: 标准三相配电盘的回路行按 A、B、C 成对重复。对于4线三角形系统，加拿大规则把 A 相定为对地电压较高的导线；不要沿用美国把高脚放在 B 相的位置。
bt-1773.backTranslation: The circuit rows of a standard three-phase panel repeat A, B, C in pairs. For a 4-wire delta system, the Canadian rule designates phase A as the conductor with the higher voltage to ground; do not use the U.S. position that places the high leg on phase B.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.panelArrangementBody: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1774.translation: 这是所选导线的规定颜色。
bt-1774.backTranslation: This is the prescribed color for the selected conductor.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.phaseNote: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1775.translation: 这里说明新安装应使用什么。墙内现有导线必须靠仪表判断——触碰任何导线之前，请先用仪表核实。
bt-1775.backTranslation: This indicates what should be used for a new installation. Existing conductors in the wall must be identified with a meter—verify with a meter before touching any conductor.

judgment.verdict: For ca-zh, wireColour.roleMeterLine: the stated meaning and its force are preserved in the independent back-translation.

bt-1776.translation: 电气计算器，展示每项结果的计算过程。无需注册，无需猜测。
bt-1776.backTranslation: Electrical calculators that show the calculation process for each result. No registration, no guessing.

judgment.verdict: The Canada Chinese line remains country-neutral, shows the working behind each result, and keeps registration and guesswork unnecessary.
